topics.title: AP updates its newsroom rules for AI
topics.summary: The Associated Press expanded its guidance for newsroom AI, allowing carefully reviewed help with research, transcription and headlines while keeping human journalists responsible for verification. It continues to prohibit generative AI from creating or altering news photos.
topics.discussionPrompt: Where would you welcome an AI assistant in a creative job, and which part would you insist a person always handle?

topics.title: A million solar panels appear in the Utah desert
topics.summary: NASA Earth Observatory highlighted a new Utah energy facility with roughly one million solar panels and large-scale battery storage. Satellite images show how dramatically the desert site changed between 2024 and 2026.
topics.discussionPrompt: A million solar panels sounds impressive, but also enormous. Would you rather see big energy projects concentrated in one place or spread across rooftops and smaller sites?

topics.title: Jürgen Klopp takes charge of Germany
topics.summary: Germany appointed former Liverpool and Borussia Dortmund manager Jürgen Klopp as national team coach through the 2030 World Cup. He succeeds Julian Nagelsmann after Germany’s early exit from the 2026 tournament.
topics.discussionPrompt: Club coaches shape a team every day, while national coaches get limited time together. What matters more in that job: tactics, motivation, picking personalities, or handling pressure?

topics.title: Merck widens access plans for a monthly HIV pill
topics.summary: Merck signed agreements allowing seven manufacturers to prepare lower-cost generic versions of an experimental once-monthly HIV prevention pill for 129 lower-income countries. The medicine is still being tested, but early licensing could speed access if approved.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a promising medicine is still in trials, should companies prepare affordable distribution early, or wait until every approval is settled? What risks come with either approach?
